result.keyword: What's the best project management tool for a startup?
result.markdown:
For most startups, I'd recommend **Linear** if you're building a tech or SaaS company, and **Notion** if you want an all-in-one workspace for managing projects, documentation, and company knowledge.

The best choice depends on your startup's stage, team size, and how you work. You don't want an overly complicated project management system when you're still moving quickly and figuring things out.

## My top 5 project management tools for startups

![Fast growing startups are built on Linear](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/piHpddRS6n9dTggcCRU3QzspXui7xfTg4qksC0xamyVTz0l5rmZLEYCGsVB7KKUouzfiOTbe-9ydzUq7UB2MFrNbZIGlaUSNjP0C8Bhd2CXnbxL2xZ05zw3USDTcATN8Ed4Fr3ygsGaA-sAB5VFRUeF1jd3BNolTylsoZGFQvpYkliFtHTL_AgaQh3gID9Z3?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. Linear**

(Best for tech startups)

- Excellent for product development and engineering.
- Clean interface and fast workflows.
- Roadmaps, sprints, bug tracking and integrations.
- Great for teams building SaaS products.

My pick for a software startup.

[Visit Linear](https://linear.app)

---

![ClickUp Review 2026: Honest In-Depth Analysis & Features](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/IhDLDOyxNDHrKHznRnMbzyjIK7Vr4N5HNf17bkJW7PnIqc3qMmYgJU2IqfzLiCBJatpbDtLiH4ToLtJwHlzGNnvDPQLGe5YS9YbILi94CXJmy4xFdhZmSjqz-lpCT9-ubZzBBG-nlRcQIsvn8DaSyQoEPl_3wXUG0qs9BW4SnIccpcG_XWfRoc5BRY_9ndY5?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. ClickUp**

(Best all-in-one solution)

- Tasks, projects, documents and goals.
- Dashboards and automation.
- Suitable for marketing, sales, operations and product.
- Highly customizable.

Best if you want one tool for the entire company.

[Visit ClickUp](https://clickup.com)

---

![Project Management Hub Template by Gridvio | Notion Marketplace](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/6e1oG6Y_aW5V5yDl222hE8Y8t-T__05L0OPLqrtY2b6KrmvS_M-QH4eaVLv4afPJUAGCFGr_eoifL-Irt3_HiUqUmKW08dRjhIxW2MfVWL_nPAWNaujkMp5zdq2VbJkW7b3h6jvrTVNAFmmVU9MPLCBztqWrhslDc_LeRhpbcV451et11onvlpgBLkBnIYcR?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. Notion**

- Project tracking and company wiki.
- Meeting notes and documentation.
- Product roadmaps and business planning.
- Flexible databases and templates.

Best for early-stage founders organizing everything.

[Visit Notion](https://notion.so)

---

![Manage your workflow with Lists, Boards, Calendar, and Timeline View • Asana](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/JoierB-tO_00cduG2D81oKuCvdoyZCElp3bd35lcWALcBpW38axGIp0CC5GaQbqWOOkxY6bkkYIgINigcMs7b9WeuaVIp_po7Lw148-t-fKTF_zSNsVOvmWGGRaLv9NtvMW858uJe_Q2tTfzckYfVF8jui4Tyz-v30ONFO8slcrt9_8tb3TIFzeV-apOQxtA?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. Asana**

- Excellent task ownership and accountability.
- Project timelines and dependencies.
- Good for cross-functional teams.
- Easy to understand and adopt.

Best for teams coordinating multiple departments.

[Visit Asana](https://asana.com)

---

![Monday.com Review: Visual Work OS for Marketing & Operations | Jira Alternatives](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/76NvYecSF06ssUogqo92ldlBp0kbpk_hgvezPK97KNjZsZ3UwqQeEGBDsMXGcEq0Qe1Z60tjx_JOghoppOd40Ca5wV9fHT6K4OeUAHjck9gcZqw0bmf3n4nK_EIBfikbehoXTAQ2U9KTTEhfvX7yOoreYkOZ0zBZztd8pFx71UOVpyBTMt5YWObff0h0jS0W?purpose=fullsize)

**5\. Monday.com**

- Visual project dashboards.
- Marketing and operational workflows.
- Automations and reporting.
- Useful as the business grows.

Best for visual management and business operations.

[Visit Monday.com](https://monday.com)

## My recommendation by startup stage

| Startup situation | My choice |
|--------|--------|
| 1–5 founders | Notion |
| 5–15 employees | ClickUp |
| SaaS / tech startup | Linear + Notion |
| Marketing / service startup | Asana |
| 15–50+ employees | Monday.com or ClickUp |
